attempts.raw_response: The group will argue that the M54-M6 link is vital for economic growth in the region, with congestion causing delays for commuters and freight alike. They believe the project could create jobs and improve safety by reducing the current weaving traffic patterns. Mr Sahota said the area had been waiting too long for the upgrade, and that the time for action was now. "We need a clear commitment from the government to deliver this link as soon as possible," he added. The campaign comes ahead of the next spending review, where transport infrastructure projects will compete for funding.
